name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.288.0 — catalog-inventory finds components.json by walking up from the recorded kit path (design.kit, else genesis design-paths.json) to the root, so monorepo hosts no longer get an empty catalog or an all-removed check; it refuses to overwrite a populated catalog with 'none' or report it all-removed, naming the folders searched; copied composition headings are demoted below the component heading (code fences untouched), so a fresh catalog re-checks as current. 7.287.0 — The genesis interview asks 8 to 12 questions before the first /spec:plan, down from 25 to 45. DISCOVERY confirms fifteen coverage keys as pre-filled guesses in rounds of four and prints the archetype as an auto-pick; MENUS auto-picks every dimension whose research menu has one unpriced, non-minority rank-1 leader (printed as Auto-picked, veto anytime) and batches the rest four to a round, with paid services always asked; FINALISTS prints a derived race-or-skip default; DECIDE prints the ops-conventions floor and a success-metric line; DESIGN_BRIEF gains one design-direction round (navigation shell, layout system, color schemes, accessibility baseline, token tiers); ROADMAP becomes notify-and-proceed. /spec:mocks reads the genesis brief instead of asking for the idea twice and confirms its inferred product assumptions in one round. question-style-gate.js narrows its product-stage exemption to questions that name a product-fact key. 7.286.0 — Decision-lint now reads three structural triggers when a spec locks. A spec with breaking: true needs a [breaking:] or [asked:] tag on a Decision, or it fails as breaking-unasked. A File Plan row that touches a dependency file prints an advisory notice and must name the packages, or it fails as missing-dependency-names. A non-empty Data Model must be tier critical and carry an existing rows: line. The File Plan parser gains a Summary column, and release Phase 0 now lists breaking specs under a warning-sign breaking heading.
